title: At the Restaurant
text:
This is a menu. It is a list of food and drinks in a restaurant. The menu has many words. Some words are soup, rice, and chicken. You can read the menu before you order.

Lisa is hungry. She looks at the menu for a long time. She wants soup and a glass of water. The waiter comes to the table and Lisa orders.

options: A list of food and drinks
Soup and a glass of water
A cake and a cup of tea

questions.text: Why does Lisa look at the menu for a long time?
options: She is choosing what to eat
She wants to leave the restaurant

questions.text: Who most likely brings the food to Lisa?

vocabulary.definition: a list of food and drinks
a place where you buy and eat food
to ask for food or drink

paragraph_translations: Bu bir menüdür. Bu, bir restoranda yiyecek ve içeceklerin listesidir. Menüde birçok kelime vardır. Bazı kelimeler çorba, pilav ve tavuktur. Sipariş vermeden önce menüyü okuyabilirsiniz.
Lisa acıkmıştır. Menüye uzun bir süre bakar. Çorba ve bir bardak su istiyor. Garson masaya gelir ve Lisa sipariş verir.
